canonicalRules: Directory order is declared authority order, never numeric ledger-ID sorting.
Directory ledger IDs are unique; at most one active ledger and it is last.
Ranges are nonempty, one merged range per ledger, in exact directory order.
Selected range may not include the active ledger.
Consecutive ranges must exhaust the prior sealed ledger and start the next at zero; only explicitly empty sealed directory rows may intervene.
First/last range may select a sealed subcut; every boundary lies within the declared ledger end.
Total entry count uses checked per-ledger subtraction and checked addition.
Same Binding/incarnation/storage epoch, authority root, chain digest and directory are required for containment/adjacency.
Unknown tags, noncanonical bytes, trailing bytes, invalid roots/counts/positions/roles and overflow reject.

installationBoundary: The native/virtual-chain source producer must independently qualify/reread actual directory and source facts. This value and its digest grant no SourceProof, publication, M4 release or deletion. Pulsar control/NMS1/lookup versions and all downstream typed consumers remain to be installed; Kafka V1 and historical frozen bytes remain unchanged.
